hero.title: Inside an OCD Loop
hero.subtitle: See how a thought can turn into a cycle.

cycle_1.thought: “What if I didn't lock the door?”

cycle_2.thought: “Wait... but did I really check properly?”

loop.notice_detail: The relief was real, but the doubt came back.

scenarios.heading: Now make it yours.
scenarios.subheading: Select a recognizable scenario to watch it move through the loop.

checking.name: Checking
checking.phrase: “What if I didn't lock the door?”
checking.thought: “What if I didn't lock the door?”
checking.takeaway_quote: I noticed that checking brings quick relief, but the doubt returns.
checking.takeaway_action: Next time the doubt appears, pause and notice the urge before automatically checking.

responsibility.name: Responsibility
responsibility.phrase: “What if I made a serious mistake?”
responsibility.thought: “What if I made a serious mistake?”
responsibility.takeaway_quote: I noticed that mental replaying tries to create certainty, but prolongs the doubt.
responsibility.takeaway_action: Next time the urge to replay arises, acknowledge the doubt without analyzing it.

contamination.name: Contamination
contamination.takeaway_quote: I noticed that washing relieves the initial discomfort, but sets up the next doubt.
contamination.takeaway_action: Next time the urge to wash hits, give yourself a moment to notice the feeling first.

symmetry.name: Just Right
symmetry.phrase: “What if I don't do this exactly right?”
symmetry.uncertainty: “Something bad might happen or feel wrong.”
symmetry.return: “Did I do it right the last time?”
symmetry.takeaway_quote: I noticed that repeating an action for a 'just right' feeling keeps the urge alive.
symmetry.takeaway_action: Next time something feels incomplete, notice the urge to redo without immediately repeating.

response_point.heading: Here is where the pattern gets interesting.
response_point.subheading: You may not control the thought or the uncertainty. But you can notice what happens next.
response_point.check_result_body: The checking brought relief. The doubt returned.
response_point.notice_result_body: The uncertainty may still feel uncomfortable. Noticing the urge gives you a moment before automatically responding.
response_point.try_again: Want to see the difference again?

compulsions.statement: Compulsions aren't always something you do.

recognition.heading: You might notice the pattern as…

takeaway.closing: Understanding the pattern is the first step toward recognizing it in real life.
